closures.observed_problem: After UI-15 implemented the last planned pages, nav:negative-controls crashed (TypeError) and two Vitest cases failed 'expected 0 to be greater than 0'.
closures.evidence: scripts/ui07-negative-controls.mjs:222; navigationFilter.spec.ts and roleNavigation.spec.ts vacuity guards
closures.root_cause: The control and guards assumed the real 160-page contract always contains at least one planned page.
closures.why_root_cause: The global contract now holds zero planned pages (UI-15 was the last owner phase with planned pages).
closures.correct_fix: The negative control constructs its own planned page from an implemented one; the filter spec proves a synthetic planned entry is dropped; the real-contract loops remain.

closures.evidence: ui-15-audit-experience.spec.ts responsive cases; element scan showed the review-count dl at 349px min-content
affected_files: seven Audit pages/components with lg-only grid tracks
closures.root_cause: A 3-column count grid with uppercase tracked labels had a min-content width wider than the mobile column, and the page grids had no minmax(0,1fr) base track to let items shrink.
closures.why_root_cause: Removing either cause alone left overflow in the scan; together the columns shrink to the viewport.
closures.correct_fix: grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] base track on every Audit page grid; repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) counts with sentence-case labels.

closures.observed_problem: Breadcrumb links were 20px tall, below the 44px target floor.
closures.root_cause: The shared UI-04 primitive rendered its RouterLink inline with no minimum height.
closures.why_root_cause: The only undersized control on the page was the breadcrumb link.
closures.correct_fix: inline-flex min-h-sv-touch items-center px-1 on the breadcrumb link (also benefits UI-08 MerchantDetail, its only other consumer).
closures.proof: 0 undersized controls on 16 Audit pages at 360px; 239 primitive/platform Vitest cases green
closures.remaining_risk: UI-16 to confirm UI-08 MerchantDetail visually

closures.evidence: ui-15 44px target test on dashboard (26 controls)
closures.root_cause: Timeline links used block text without a minimum height.
closures.why_root_cause: All 26 reported controls were those links.
closures.correct_fix: flex min-h-sv-touch items-center with an inner truncating span.

closures.observed_problem: Finance Audit subtitle claimed maker and checker are recorded on each event.
closures.evidence: desktop-dark-audit-finance.png review against AuditEvent context shapes
closures.root_cause: Copy generalised from payment events to every finance event.
closures.why_root_cause: Only payment validation/override events carry maker/checker context.
closures.correct_fix: '…wherever the event recorded them'; readiness matrix records the card-level gap.

closures.observed_problem: New Audit files used text-sv-text-primary, which is not a generated utility (silently uncoloured).
closures.root_cause: Token name (color-text-primary) assumed to be the utility name.
closures.correct_fix: text-sv-text everywhere; no other use exists in the codebase.

closures.observed_problem: Route tests failed for fixture ids such as 01JAUDITEVENT…; release-audit fixture ids contain U/I/L/O.
closures.root_cause: The first route constraint used the strict Crockford alphabet; synthetic fixture ids do not.
closures.why_root_cause: The constraint's only job is to keep fixed words from matching as ids; the server validates real ULIDs.
closures.correct_fix: Record-id segment = 26 alphanumerics; unit fixtures use valid ULID shapes.

closures.observed_problem: Pint reported a parse error in AuditLogController after an automated edit.
closures.root_cause: A PowerShell double-quoted string turned a Markdown backtick plus 'f' into a form-feed byte inside a PHP comment.
closures.why_root_cause: Byte scan showed a 0x0C where the backtick stood.
closures.correct_fix: Comment rewritten; no control bytes remain (git grep for control characters is empty).

closures.observed_problem: The first test of the first audit.spec run after a cold preview start timed out waiting for the first event row.
closures.evidence: 1 failed / 34 passed; the same test then passed 3/3 with --repeat-each=3 and the full set passed 123/123
closures.root_cause: Cold first navigation (lazy chunks) exceeded the 5s expect timeout; not reproducible.
closures.why_root_cause: No source change between the failing and passing runs.
closures.correct_fix: None in source; recorded. Whole-product and focused runs pre-warm via the preview readiness helper.
closures.remaining_risk: first-navigation latency on a cold preview

closures.observed_problem: The development container ran Laravel 12.62.0 while composer.lock pins 12.69.3 (REM-DEP-003).
closures.root_cause: The vendor directory is a named Docker volume that does not follow lockfile changes on the host.
closures.why_root_cause: composer show reported 12.62.0 inside the container.
closures.correct_fix: composer install inside the app container (documented named-volume procedure); no lockfile change.

closures.observed_problem: gitleaks reported 3 generic-api-key findings in new UI-15 evidence JSON.
closures.evidence: gitleaks dir over the 226 changed/untracked paths: audit-security-matrix.json line 17; page-visual-acceptance.json lines 302-303
closures.root_cause: Data shape: a field named 'api' beside a slash-joined token, and SHA-256 values keyed by screenshot filenames containing 'access', match the generic key heuristic on one line. No secret was present.
closures.why_root_cause: The redacted matches were a description string and two screenshot hashes.
closures.correct_fix: Renamed the matrix field to 'surface' and emitted evidence hashes as {file, sha256} objects on separate lines; no allowlist, rule, path or entropy change.
closures.proof: no leaks found in both scans; ui15:check OK

closures.observed_problem: Audit export accepts Finance/Compensation domains after their separate read rights are revoked.
closures.evidence: Pre-fix PostgreSQL: two assertions expected 403, received 201; original 228-path handoff authenticated.
closures.root_cause: Export boundaries checked audit.export and branch scope but not the selected domain read keys; workers did not resolve live requester authority.
closures.why_root_cause: Validated domains directly selected AuditEvent action sets; masking does not deny a revoked event domain.
closures.correct_fix: Single fresh membership/permission authorizer with exhaustive existing-domain mapping shared at request, generation and file access boundaries.
closures.test_result: Post-fix run unfinished: Docker/WSL unresponsive; no pass claimed. Pre-fix two failures received 201 instead of 403.
closures.proof: Pint passed on seven Codex files; Composer validation/audit and npm audit clean; post-fix verification blocked.
closures.remaining_risk: Repair and post-revocation signed-stream behavior are unverified; RELEASE BLOCKED.
closures.entry_condition: Docker/WSL restored; complete affected tests/static checks and current production PHP image proof before staging
